rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the academic study of the mind and behavior.

example.english: I recently started studying psychology because I want to understand why people have different emotions.
example.traditional: 我最近開始學心理學，想了解人點解會有唔同情緒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 ci2 hok6 sam1 lei5 hok6 soeng2 liu5 gaai2 jan4 dim2 gaai2 wui5 jau5 m4 tung4 cing4 seoi5

rows.note: Use this for the mental and emotional makeup of a particular person, group, or activity rather than for the academic discipline.

example.english: In business, you cannot just look at the numbers; you also need to understand the customer's psychology.
example.traditional: 做生意唔可以只睇數字，仲要捉到客人嘅心理。
example.jyutping: zou6 saang1 ji3 m4 ho2 ji5 zi2 tai2 sou3 zi6 zung6 jiu3 zuk1 dou3 haak3 jan4 ge3 sam1 lei5

rows.note: Use this for the characteristic mindset or outlook of a person or group, especially when attitudes are the focus.

example.english: After conceding a goal, the whole team's psychology immediately became anxious.
example.traditional: 畀人入咗一球之後，成隊嘅心態即刻變得好急躁。
example.jyutping: bei2 jan4 jap6 zo2 jat1 kau4 zi1 hau6 sing4 deoi6 ge3 sam1 taai3 zik1 hak1 bin3 dak1 hou2 gap1 cou3
